parent.receipt_resolution: one immutable receipt root; no mixing archived or failed directories

prefix_domain.unmeasured_prefix_policy: replay from frozen endpoint before use; never assume zero authority
prefix_domain.readout: exact learner-order sequential binary32 replay with bitwise comparison and signed-zero identity

stages.PF2-0: verify parent hashes, receipt-root presence, topology counts, and baseline/target bitwise replay
stages.PF2-1: build raw-support graph, overlay helpful components and k-star classes, and certify prefix coverage
stages.PF2-2: run bounded coordinate-group convex screens; disqualifying only for complete raw-support-disjoint groups
stages.PF2-3: exactly replay bounded joint prefix candidates on cloned f32 states
stages.PF2-4: audit final bytes and assign engineering-only feasibility class

topology_use.raw_authority: defines candidate support and group connectivity
topology_use.immediate_rows: distributed backbone candidates after threshold-gated rows
topology_use.no_local_authority_rows: explicit blockers; exact impossibility only within complete declared domain
topology_use.shared_rows: retain in one exact-replay group; do not split to manufacture additivity

relaxation.object: sum of per-coordinate convex hulls of exact committed prefix effects
relaxation.purpose: bounded screen and prioritization, not a repair or universal feasibility proof
relaxation.raw_disjoint_outside_result: valid rejection only when every row in the group is incident to at most one candidate coordinate and prefix coverage is complete
relaxation.shared_component_outside_result: prioritization only; exact replay remains required

exact_replay.large_group_strategy: deterministic bounded beam seeded by the relaxation and fixed RMT authority scores
exact_replay.tie_break: mismatch count, total ULP distance, residual L2, maximum absolute residual, stable prefix tuple

fail_closed: declared RMT receipt root missing or mixed with another root
baseline or target sequential-f32 replay mismatch
negative feasibility claim with incomplete prefix coverage
group exceeds declared row, coordinate, iteration, replay, or memory budget
any write to Q10-RMT or another sealed predecessor
any scientific, behavioral, or DH08B field
allowed_outputs: new Q10-PF2 engineering receipts under q10-pf2-v1 only
candidate prefix selections for cloned states
exact sequential-f32 mismatch and geometry diagnostics
coverage, relaxation, replay-budget, and feasibility-class receipts
